name: Jarvis Bridge priority
description: Bridge task runs get the local model first: interactive chat turns on the same model provider wait while a bridge run is active, chat runs pause at tool calls, and chat runs using the model are stopped when a bridge run starts.

bridgeJobNames.description: Automation (cron job) names whose runs are bridge runs.

bridgePromptMarkers.description: A non-interactive run whose prompt contains one of these strings is a bridge run.

chatTriggers.description: Run triggers that count as interactive chat work.

holdChat.description: Make new chat turns wait while a bridge run is active.

holdChatTools.description: Pause a running chat at its next tool call while a bridge run is active.

preemptInFlightChat.description: Stop chat runs using the model when a bridge run starts, when a chat model call starts during a bridge run, and when a tool pause reaches its limit.

notifyChat.description: Tell the chat user when their turn is held or stopped for a bridge run.

sameProviderOnly.description: Only hold/stop chat work that uses the same model provider as the bridge run.

maxChatHoldMinutes.description: Longest a single chat turn waits before it runs anyway.

maxToolHoldMinutes.description: Longest a chat tool call waits (also capped by the plugin's before_tool_call hook budget, max 10 min).

maxBridgeHoldMinutes.description: A bridge run that never reports its end stops blocking chat after this long.
